_about: Generated by combat/tools/build-threats.ts: what each monster did to the reference build over many TAS fights.
perMin and dodged are how often a threat came and how much the TAS avoided -- mostly the monster's, not the build's.
refDamage and deathShare are the reference build's; combat/src/advise.ts works damage out again for any build.
